proposals.before: Some treat the Comprehensive Track's three xinsi offsets, which differ from the Yuan History, as Yuan–Ming revisions—this is mistaken.
proposals.after: Some treat the Comprehensive Track's three xinsi offsets, which differ from the Yuan History, as determinations fixed by Yuan Tong—this is mistaken.
proposals.reason: Chinese 元統 is the personal name Yuan Tong; 'Yuan–Ming revisions' invents a polity gloss and erases the named person.

proposals.before: Some take the Comprehensive Track's xinsi three responses, differing from the Yuan History, and call them Yuan–Ming determinations—this is wrong.
proposals.after: Some take the Comprehensive Track's xinsi three responses, differing from the Yuan History, and call them determinations fixed by Yuan Tong—this is wrong.
proposals.reason: Chinese 元統所定 means fixed by Yuan Tong; 'Yuan–Ming determinations' is not a literal rendering of the personal name.

proposals.before: Alternate method: take the day-rate from the ready reckoners; where it is close to the small cloth value in the slow-rapid ephemeris, subtract it; a remainder of 820 or less gives the applicable limit.
proposals.after: Alternate method: take the day-rate from the ready reckoners; where it is close to the small remainder in the slow-rapid ephemeris, subtract it; a remainder of 820 or less gives the applicable limit.
proposals.reason: Chinese 小布 is a corruption of 小餘 ('small remainder'); rendering it as 'small cloth' obscures the calendrical technical term.

proposals.before: Another method: inspect the day-rate in the ready reckoners; where one is close to the small cloth of the slow-rapid ephemeris, subtract it; if the remainder is 820 or below, that is the limit to use.
proposals.after: Another method: inspect the day-rate in the ready reckoners; where one is close to the small remainder of the slow-rapid ephemeris, subtract it; if the remainder is 820 or below, that is the limit to use.
proposals.reason: Chinese 小布 is a corruption of 小餘; 'small cloth' is not a meaningful literal calendrical reading.

proposals.before: For the first quarter-hour of the midnight double-hour, all use first, second, third, and fourth as auspicious, naming beyond the count.
proposals.after: For the first quarter-hour of the midnight double-hour, all use first, second, third, and fourth as designations, naming beyond the count.
proposals.reason: In context of 命之 naming, 好 is a corruption of 號 ('designation'); 'auspicious' mistranslates the naming procedure.

proposals.before: To seek the mean nodal day after new moon: set the nodal-cycle remainder; wind-qi new-moon sequence.
proposals.after: To seek the mean nodal day after new moon: set the nodal-cycle remainder; use the solar-term and new-moon sequence.
proposals.reason: Chinese 風氣朔歷 is a corruption of 用氣朔歷; 'wind-qi' is not a meaningful literal reading.

proposals.before: To find the lunar-path and equator fixed difference: multiply the crossing's fixed-limit degree by the initial or final limit, scale by a thousand, and express in degrees.
proposals.after: To find the lunar-path and equator fixed difference: take that crossing's fixed-limit degree, subtract from and multiply by the initial or final limit, scale the product by a thousand, and express it in degrees.
proposals.reason: Chinese 相減相乘 requires both subtract and multiply against the initial/final limit; the idiomatic omits the subtract step present in the source and literal.

proposals.before: Procedure to derive the addition-and-subtraction difference: Subtract the fixed rotation accumulation from the separation degree as dividend and divide by the number of days from new moon to quarter (or the corresponding interval) as divisor. If the separation exceeds the quotient's basis, the result is an addition difference; if less, a subtraction difference.
proposals.after: Procedure to derive the addition-and-subtraction difference: Subtract the fixed rotation accumulation from the separation degree as dividend and divide by the new-moon/quarter/full-moon separation days as divisor. If the separation degree is greater, the quotient is an addition difference; if less, a subtraction difference.
proposals.reason: Source 視相距度多爲加差，少爲減差 compares separation degree to the rotation accumulation, not an obscure 'quotient's basis'; the current idiomatic obscures that rule.

proposals.before: For the next palace, add the palace rate of 20°4381 cumulatively; discard the qi quadrant when full—each sum gives a palace's lower-half post-crossing boundary accumulation.
proposals.after: For the next palace, add the palace rate of 20°4381 cumulatively; discard the qi quadrant when full—each sum gives, under that palace, the post-half-node palace-boundary accumulated degree.
proposals.reason: 某宮下 means under/for that palace; 半產交 is the half-node crossing (likely 半交), not a 'lower-half' bound. The idiomatic invents 'lower-half'.

proposals.before: To seek the next palace, cumulatively add palace rate 20 degrees 4381; when full remove the qi quadrant—each yields a palace's lower-half node-crossing after-palace-boundary accumulated degree.
proposals.after: To seek the next palace, cumulatively add palace rate 20 degrees 4381; when full remove the qi quadrant—each yields under that palace the post-half-node after-palace-boundary accumulated degree.
proposals.reason: Same misreading of 某宮下 and 半產交/半交 as 'lower-half' rather than palace-scoped post-half-node accumulation.

proposals.before: Take one-fifth of the morning fraction and add it to the watches to obtain the watch rate.
proposals.after: Take one-fifth of the morning fraction as the watch rate.
proposals.reason: Corrupt 加們 is not 'add to the watches'; calendar sense is 晨分五之一爲更率 (one-fifth of morning fraction is the watch rate), which the following 更率五而一爲點率 confirms.

proposals.before: Take one-fifth of the morning fraction and add to watches as watch rate.
proposals.after: Take one-fifth of the morning fraction as the watch rate.
proposals.reason: Literal likewise invents adding to watches from corrupt 加們; the formula is one-fifth of morning fraction equals the watch rate.

decisions.reason: s0027 目爲元統所定 rejects treating the Tonggui xinsi offsets as fixed by the person 元統 (Yuan Tong); 'Yuan–Ming revisions' invents a dynasty gloss and erases the named individual.
Literal likewise misreads 元統所定 as Yuan–Ming; determinations fixed by Yuan Tong restores the personal name in 元統所定.

decisions.after: Alternate method: take the day-rate from the ready reckoners; where one is smaller than and close to the slow-rapid ephemeris, subtract it; a remainder of 820 or less gives the applicable limit.
decisions.reason: 'Small cloth' is wrong, but emending 小布 to 小餘 is also wrong: Siku Mingshi reads 較小而相近, so the day-rate must be smaller than and close to the slow-rapid ephemeris, not a 'small remainder'.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 有與遲疾厯較小而相近者以減之

decisions.after: Another method: inspect the day-rate in the ready reckoners; where one is smaller than and close to the slow-rapid ephemeris, subtract it; if the remainder is 820 or below, that is the limit to use.
decisions.reason: Same source corruption as r0003: Siku reads 較小而相近, so literal must say smaller than and close to the slow-rapid ephemeris, not 'small remainder'.

decisions.after: For the quarter-hours of the chu and zheng halves of the double-hour, all use first, second, third, and fourth in sequence, naming beyond the count.
decisions.reason: 'Auspicious' is wrong, but 好→號 is also wrong: Siku reads 為序, and 初正時 means the chu and zheng halves of the double-hour, not the midnight double-hour.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 初正時之刻皆以初一二三四為序於算外命之

decisions.after: To seek the mean nodal day after new moon: set the nodal-cycle remainder (see the solar-term and new-moon calendar).
decisions.reason: 'Wind-qi' is nonsense, but emending 風氣朔歷 to 用氣朔歷 is wrong: Siku marks a cross-reference 見氣朔厯 after 置交終分, not an instruction to 'use' the sequence.
s0287 與初末限相減相乘 requires both subtract and multiply with the initial/final limit; the before omits the subtract step.
s0325 視相距度多爲加差，少爲減差 judges by whether the separation degree is greater or less, and 朔弦望相距 are the new-/quarter-/full-moon separation days; 'quotient's basis' obscures that rule.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 視相距度多爲加差，少爲減差

decisions.after: For the next palace, add the palace rate of 30°4381 cumulatively; discard the qi quadrant when full—each sum gives, under that palace, the post-half-node and post-middle-node palace-boundary accumulated degree.
decisions.reason: 'Lower-half' is wrong and 某宮下 is under that palace, but 半產交 is not merely 半交: Siku reads 半交中交後, and the same clause has palace rate 三十度四三八一, not 二十.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 累加宫率三十度四三八一滿氣象限去之各得某宫下半交中交後宫界積度

decisions.after: To seek the next palace, cumulatively add palace rate 30 degrees 4381; when full remove the qi quadrant—each yields under that palace the post-half-node and post-middle-node after-palace-boundary accumulated degree.
decisions.reason: Same as r0009: Siku has 某宫下半交中交後 and palace rate 三十度四三八一; stopping at post-half-node and keeping 20° leaves the unit under-corrected.

decisions.after: Take one-fifth of the morning fraction and double it to obtain the watch rate.
decisions.reason: 'Add to the watches' from 加們 is wrong, but deleting the verb is also wrong: Siku reads 加倍為更率, doubling one-fifth of the morning fraction (i.e. night/5) for the watch rate, which then divides by five for the point rate.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以晨分五之一加倍為更率

decisions.after: Take one-fifth of the morning fraction and double it as the watch rate.
decisions.reason: Same as r0011: Siku 加倍為更率 requires doubling, not bare equation of one-fifth of the morning fraction with the watch rate.
